newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate steady, baht falls late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate steady, baht falls late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate was steady at 10.00 percent late on Wednesday compared with 9.75-10.00 in the morning amid high demand for funds ahead of tomorrow's holiday, dealers said.
Thursday is a public holiday due to King's Birthday.
"The market was relatively quiet today as most banks appeared to already square their position," one dealer at a foreign bank said.
The interbank rate is likely to remain high on Friday as bank's borrowed to meet central bank's reserve requirements, dealers said.
All commercial banks have to meet the Bank of Thailand's reserve requirement on seventh and 22nd of each month.
The baht fell to 25.565-25.570 to the dollar late from 25.549-25.552 in early morning on late dollar buying, dealers said.
"Players were buying the dollar again in the afternoon after offloading it in the morning. They expect the U.S. unit to make a possible rebound abroad," one currency dealer said.
The one-month dollar/baht swap premium was quoted at 8.00/8.50 satangs per a dollar late, unchanged from early morning trade.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the dollar/baht mid-rate at 25.55 versus 25.56 on Tuesday.
